title: Westliche Stadtmauerstraße, Erlangen
description:
The Room
A sunny, newly renovated room in a well-maintained older apartment building. The room is fully furnished—just bring your suitcases; we’ve got everything else. The room includes a bed, desk, dresser, bookshelf, and closet. No IKEA hassle, no moving truck—just move in and feel at home.
The light-filled, fully furnished room is ideal for studying, working, or simply relaxing.
Size: 16 m2
The room is available immediately.

The Shared Apartment
We’re a group of four—students and young professionals. Things are laid-back here—everyone does their own thing, but we also cook together sometimes and have coffee on the balcony. In the summer, you can use the garden in the courtyard—and yet you’re still just a 2-minute walk from downtown. What we’re looking for: respectful coexistence, reliability, and a laid-back atmosphere.

Amenities
Balcony and garden access available
Kitchen – brand-new appliances, including a coffee maker, oven, and steam cooker
Washer & dryer – brand-new, shared in the laundry room
Bathroom & hallway (shared, approx. 20 m2 extra)
DSL/Wi-Fi throughout the apartment
Bicycle storage room + parking space in the courtyard
Parking available with a resident parking permit
No pets

The location – it doesn’t get much better than this in Erlangen
Just 150 meters north of the train station, with direct access to the city center and all its restaurants and shopping options. The Schlosspark—one of the most beautiful parks in the city center—is a 3-minute walk away. Here, you can go for a morning jog through the park and still be in the pedestrian zone in just 3 minutes by evening. Or you can simply take the train: The main station, with ICE and regional train connections, is a 2-minute walk away. Buses and trams heading in all directions depart from here. It doesn’t get any more central than this...

Contact
Sound good? Then send us a quick note telling us a little about yourself—a few sentences about who you are, your studies or job, and why you’re coming to or staying in Würzburg. We’ll get back to you soon and easily set up a viewing appointment.
Please include your name, email address, and phone number—it’ll make everything much easier and faster.

title: Obere Karlstraße, Erlangen
description: Centrally located, beautifully furnished, three room apartment in a charming listed house in the city of Erlangen. Long Term Stays: More than 3 Months : better conditions ! The stunning palace park, university library and clinics are in the immediate vicinity. Stucco ceiling, wooden floors, new kitchen, new bathroom, washing machine, dishwasher, WLAN, TV, complete kitchen equipment with toaster, microwave, kettle, Nespresso coffee machine etc. make this place the perfect location for any foreigner looking to settle in and get to know Germany/Erlangen by living in a historic yet restored and renovated house.The train station is within 5 minutes walking distance and it is only 200 meters to the pedestrian zone that offers plenty of shops, coffee shops, restaurants. . Disclaimer: This apartment will not be rented out for turistic purposes, the minimum rental time is 2 month. Possibility to sit outside in quiet, green backyard. Safe area!
